title: Excess Layer Credit Applied to a Re-Rated HomeFlood Premium
content:
A HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies re-rated term premium, worked out when an Elevation Certificate review is completed, carries a layer credit. The credit follows the customer's Tidemark Excess Flood policy — a policy of the Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines) — in status active at the same property address. The Excess Flood program allows only one live policy on an address.

**In force on the term start.** That Excess Flood policy counts as in force on the term start when it took effect on or before the term start. The layer credit is decided as of the term start and is not added or removed mid-term.

| Active Excess Flood policy at the HomeFlood address | Took effect on or before the term start | Excess building limit | Layer credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | at least 1,000,000 USD (1000000) | the tier's package credit percent, 5 percent |
| yes | yes | below 1,000,000 USD | 3 percent |
| yes | no (took effect after the term start) | any | none |
| no | — | — | none |

**Records read.** The credit is read from the Excess Flood policy record: its status, its property address, its effective date and its excess building limit.

**Form of the credit.** The credit is a percent by which the re-rated term premium is reduced.

**How credits combine.** The credits of the re-rated term premium are added to one another, never multiplied. Their sum is capped at the tier's ceiling on combined credits, 15 percent. The factored amount is reduced once by that capped sum, before the loss-of-use charge is added.

## Hypothetical cases

- **Earlier effective date.** An active Excess Flood policy at the address took effect four months before the HomeFlood term start, with an excess building limit of 2,000,000 USD. The credit is 5 percent.
- **Same day, smaller limit.** An Excess Flood policy with a 500,000 USD excess building limit took effect on the same day as the HomeFlood term start. "On or before" includes the same day, so the credit is 3 percent.
- **Later effective date.** An active Excess Flood policy took effect a month after the term start. No layer credit applies to that term.
- **Exactly at the limit.** An excess building limit of exactly 1,000,000 USD is "at least" that figure and earns 5 percent.
